chunks: As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī says: This discourse had already passed [appeared] in what preceded, except that we repeated it here because of the difference between the two narrations.

key_terms.الشَّرِيفُ: The Noble One, a title for As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī

ai.seo_question: Why did As-Sayyid ar-Raḍī repeat a sermon in Nahj al-Balagha that had already been presented?
ai.summary: Sharif al-Raḍī justifies the repetition of this sermon on Islam by emphasizing the textual variations (ikhtilaf) across different chains of narration, a hallmark of his meticulous compilation method in *Nahj al-Balagha*. This editorial choice underscores the scholarly commitment to preserving authentic variants rather than forcing a single uniform text, thereby enriching the reader's understanding of the sermon's nuances.
